mapper.sql: t.id, t.subject_id, t.stage_goal_id, t.title, t.unit_id, t.planned_amount, t.status, t.version, t.created_at, t.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task t WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM task t WHERE t.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (subject_id, stage_goal_id, title, unit_id, planned_amount, status, version) VALUES (#{subjectId}, #{stageGoalId}, #{title}, #{unitId}, #{plannedAmount}, #{status}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET subject_id = #{subjectId}, stage_goal_id = #{stageGoalId}, title = #{title}, unit_id = #{unitId}, planned_amount = #{plannedAmount}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_record WHERE task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.title AS title, t.subject_id AS subject_id, t.unit_id AS unit_id, u.name AS unit_name, t.planned_amount AS planned_amount, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS completed_amount, GREATEST(t.planned_amount - COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0), 0) AS remaining_amount FROM task t JOIN study_unit u ON u.id = t.unit_id LEFT JOIN study_record r ON r.task_id = t.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.id = #{taskId} GROUP BY t.id, t.title, t.subject_id, t.unit_id, u.name, t.planned_amount
